pages.title: Sterile Neutrino
pages.text: A neutrino that feels no force except gravity: no weak interaction, no electromagnetism, nothing. It passes through anything without a trace, which makes it a candidate for dark matter. Keeping hold of one is like trying to catch smoke with a sieve.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Neutrino Condenser, Degenerate Matter Chunks released neutrinos as their electrons merged into protons. Most were ordinary, but a few did not interact at all, and I trapped them by gravity alone.
